data.rationale: The proposal gets the correct IMDb→Rotten Tomatoes→email procedure and subject/body templates, but it ends with "Send" (the true workflow says never send and click Discard), it models the recipient as a full email plus name instead of the single {friend} parameter, and it uses "Open" for site navigation rather than switching tabs. The contradictory send/discard step and the inconsistent parameter names ({name} vs recipient_name, director/runtime/rating left unparameterized) would make automation risky or incorrect.
